title: Accession hard-fails on Biblicus reindex after local write; S3/GraphQL never run
description:
## Expected
Accession should degrade or continue to S3 sync + GraphQL updates when Biblicus reindex fails (or require corpus metadata upfront with a clear preflight).

## Observed
Worktree corpus lacked metadata/. run_biblicus_reindex_for_accession raised after local import files were written. Because the raise is before maybe_sync_accession_to_s3 and apply_record_changes, archives never reached S3 and GraphQL never updated. Assignments stayed claimed.

## Notes
Copying metadata/ from the main clone unblocked reindex. Default accession also skips S3 unless --sync-s3-apply is passed — easy silent under-delivery on the first live HTML archival path.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Fixed on epic/e2e-ingestion: biblicus_reindex_failed is caught after local write; S3 sync + GraphQL accession records still apply with reindex marked degraded in the manifest.
